author: ai
text: The United States exports 12.6% of the oil it produces (U.S. Energy Information Administration, 2025, preliminary) and 36% of the wheat it produces (FAOSTAT, 2024). Canada supplied 88% of its imports of potash, a potassium fertiliser (FAOSTAT, 2024). The United Kingdom supplied 17% of its major arms imports (SIPRI, 2021–2025). It has 341.8 million people and a GDP of US$30.8 trillion, ranked first of 186 places (World Bank, 2025).
